changesMade: CC BY 4.0 section 3(a)(1)(B) disclosure of modifications: (1) selected 20-record subsets out of 271 (IE Donadea) and 134 (LU Mersch) records; (2) omitted non-core verbatim columns (including measurementAccuracy, identificationID, basisOfRecord, coordinateUncertaintyInMeters, verbatimCoordinateSystem, geodeticDatum); (3) populated the countryCode column from GBIF's interpreted occurrence record (verbatim records contain country only); (4) sorted rows deterministically and wrapped them in a reconstructed tab-delimited UTF-8 DwC-A ZIP envelope (meta.xml, occurrence.txt, measurementorfact.txt) because the publisher IPT archive was unreachable. No species names, coordinates, diameters, heights, statuses, or microhabitat codes were altered. Note: interpreting verbatimCoordinates as plot-local metres (X, Y) is an unverified inference that contradicts the verbatim field verbatimCoordinateSystem='decimal degrees', and test polygons in FixtureQualificationTests.cs (50x100 m and 100x100 m) are constructed test constants with no cited survey source.
